title: A2UI
explanation: The official MessageProcessor applies createSurface, updateComponents and updateDataModel. The Lit A2uiSurface renders the result. The basic catalog contains no arbitrary HTML; open-ended and mixed examples compose a separate sandboxed host region.

title: AG-UI
explanation: The official event models and EventEncoder frame RUN_STARTED, STATE_SNAPSHOT, tool events, STATE_DELTA and RUN_FINISHED as server-sent events. The frontend applies the accepted patches. The event protocol carries UI state; it does not define its component catalog.

title: MCP Apps
explanation: The FastMCP tool advertises _meta.ui.resourceUri. The host discovers tools, reads text/html;profile=mcp-app and mounts a sandboxed iframe. The view initializes through JSON-RPC postMessage. Tool results arrive as notifications and button actions round-trip through the host allowlist.

title: json-render
explanation: A Zod catalog defines permitted props. defineCatalog and defineRegistry connect those contracts to official React Renderer. Static mode uses fixed slots. Declarative mode passes the bounded element map. GeneratedView is a custom catalog component containing a sandboxed iframe.

title: OpenUI Lang
explanation: The adapter converts the graph into assignments such as root = Stack([title, units], "column"). Forward references resolve in the official OpenUI Lang parser and React renderer. createLibrary and defineComponent supply the component signatures and renderers.

title: Harness integration
explanation: A bounded loop proposes render_ui, dispatches the allowlisted tool, validates the spec, records the tool observation and returns a final assistant response. The history and budget are visible. Replay scripts this sequence; the optional live provider generates the UI spec but does not make this a general autonomous coding agent.
